name: Will She?
source:
As spring semester comes to a close and students start getting ready for finals, you might need a little fun before they get destroyed emotionally... 

Thankfully at Astral University, the Activities Bureau is holding an 'End of the Year' Dance to celebrate another school year passing and you are invited!!

Well... of course you are- you're a part of the Activities Bureau... so you have to help set it up. You are grouped with 4 others but it seems one of your group members is quite special to you...Connie Alvarez.

You want her to be your date for the dance but it is in 5 days. Will you be able to build up the courage to ask her in time, or will you have to go to the dance alone this year?

[From [url=https://aoiidee.itch.io/will-she]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
随着春季学期即将结束，学生们开始为期末考试做准备，在他们的情绪被摧毁之前，你可能需要一点乐趣…… 

值得庆幸的是，在星体大学，活动局正在举办“年终”舞会，庆祝又一个学年过去，邀请你！！

嗯……当然你是——你是活动局的一员……所以你必须帮助建立它。你与其他4人分在一组，但似乎你的组员之一对你来说非常特别……康妮·阿尔瓦雷斯 (Connie Alvarez)。

你想让她成为你舞会的约会对象，但还要过5天。今年你能否鼓起勇气及时向她提出请求，还是必须独自去参加舞会？

[来自[url=https://aoiidee.itch.io/will-she]itch.io[/url]]
